verses.en: LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
verses.pt: Ah SENHOR, como têm se multiplicado meus adversários! Muitos se levantam contra mim.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David. When he went in flight from Absalom his son.> Lord, how greatly are they increased who make attacks on me! in great numbers they come against me.

verses.en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
verses.pt: Muitos dizem de minha alma: Não há salvação para ele em Deus.(Selá)
verses.en_web: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Unnumbered are those who say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. (Selah.)

verses.en: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.pt: Porém tu, SENHOR, és escudo para mim; minha glória, e o que levanta minha cabeça.
verses.en_web: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
verses.en_bbe: But your strength, O Lord, is round me, you are my glory and the lifter up of my head.

verses.en: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.pt: Com minha voz eu clamei ao SENHOR; e ele me ouviu desde o monte de sua santidade. (Selá)
verses.en_web: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: I send up a cry to the Lord with my voice, and he gives me an answer from his holy hill. (Selah.)

verses.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
verses.pt: Eu me deitei, e dormi; acordei, porque o SENHOR me sustentava.
verses.en_web: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
verses.en_bbe: I took my rest in sleep, and then again I was awake; for the Lord was my support.

verses.en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.pt: Eu não temerei ainda que sejam dez mil pessoas que se ponham ao redor de mim.
verses.en_web: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
verses.en_bbe: I will have no fear, though ten thousand have come round me, putting themselves against me.

verses.en: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, SENHOR, salva-me, meu Deus; pois feriste os queixos de todos meus inimigos; e quebraste os dentes dos maus.
verses.en_web: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: Come to me, Lord; keep me safe, O my God; for you have given all my haters blows on their face-bones; the teeth of the evil-doers have been broken by you.

verses.en: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
verses.pt: A salvação vem do SENHOR; sobre o teu povo seja tua bênção. (Selá) Salmo de Davi para o regente, com instrumentos de cordas:
verses.en_web: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. Your blessing be on your people. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Salvation comes from the Lord; your blessing is on your people. (Selah.)
